name: ReCFG (rectified guidance coefficients)
plain: Uses a pre-measured table of E[cond]/E[uncond] ratios per timestep as the weight on the unconditional. Needs an offline table pass.
math: x̂ = w·c + (1−w)·R_t·u; R_t = ratio table entry, 1 gives plain CFG
